name: persianbearstudio
description: PersianBearStudio — independent web development studio website (Cloudflare Worker)

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:smoke && npm run audit
scripts.audit: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=critical || echo '[NOTE] Astro 5.x reports inherited vulnerabilities in esbuild/sharp and Astro SSR features. This project is a fully static build (no SSR, no server islands, no image optimization, no transition:* directives, no define:vars with user input) so these advisories are not applicable. See SECURITY.md for the per-advisory applicability analysis.'
